Comment EBOOK and I'll send you the full Faceless AI Affiliate ebook. 🔒

One-time pays once. Recurring keeps paying. Same referral, same work, completely different year.

A one-time payout resets you to zero every month — you have to sell the same number of people again just to stand still. That's a treadmill with a payout button.

Take four referrals. At month twelve, on a recurring offer, all four can still be active. On a one-time offer, the count is zero — you got paid for the post, not for the back catalogue.

Which means the metric that actually matters is churn. Recurring only compounds if people stay, so promote tools people keep using. And the first real milestone isn't a big number — it's a handful of recurring referrals covering the tool you're promoting.
